verdict.rationale: Pricing docs state the first $1.00 is free on a no-markup, per-call prepaid balance billed at fractions of a cent per call, and failed per-success calls settle at $0.00. Calls using your own provider keys are never metered, and the open-source project can be self-hosted, so a developer can prototype tool connections without paying. Missing for 10: the $1 credit is modest with no stated call volume it covers for typical endpoints, and no independent hands-on report of prototyping within the free credit.
